newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Fogade invites bidders for Cabelum.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Fogade invites bidders for Cabelum.

text.p: Venezuela's state Deposits Guarantee Fund (Fogade) said Tuesday it was inviting bidders to come forward for aluminum conductors manufacturer Conductores de Aluminio del Caroni CA (Cabelum).
Fogade said in a release that registrations for the public auction of 100 percent of Cabelum's shares will begin on October 14.
Fogade inherited 70 percent of Cabelum in return for financial aid given during the 1994-5 financial sector crisis. The remaining 30 percent belongs to state-owned aluminum smelter Alcasa.
